provenance: This is a lossless a91 source supplement. It does not amend the provenance of the pre-existing a4c4dd597d716889cb76d6ba04f9bebb845dcdc8 standalone-layout archive or older 0.x snapshots. The 0.x archive location describes the retired layout under test, not this supplement source commit.
scope: Function disposition only; no claim of successful test execution, release acceptance, blanket exemption, or automatic equivalence between historical and current gates. Existing archived bytes and records remain unchanged.
body_hash_definition: SHA256 of exact original UTF-8 bytes from the first body statement line through end_lineno inclusive, retaining original LF. function_sha256 includes the original def line as well.
integration_status: The original file is retained here. The three coverage controls remain active in tests/test_release_gate.py, and live privacy edge cases are exercised by release/tests/test_source_gate.py. This index records source disposition and does not record a successful release run.

functions.name: test_repository_fixture_passes
functions.reason: The old synthetic demo distribution is retired. Current shared-product and candidate-manifest positive controls cover the supported single-product model; they do not execute the historical standalone fixture.

functions.name: test_gate_rejects_tracked_file_outside_every_component_release
functions.reason: Independent per-component release ownership is retired. The current tracked-public-source boundary and fixed shared release assets replace the product layout, not the old each-file-to-component partition oracle.

functions.name: test_gate_rejects_unignored_untracked_secret_file
functions.replacement: Sealed clean commit checkout; release/check_source.py:check; release/report_gate.py
functions.reason: Release inputs are the sealed clean commit, not arbitrary untracked workstation files. Current source and asset privacy checks remain mandatory. This does not claim an automated untracked-file discovery or dirty-workspace scanner.

functions.name: test_gate_rejects_selection_that_reaches_outside_the_component
functions.reason: There is no supported component selector. Fixed shared-product inputs and artifact integrity replace that removed mechanism; the original selector escape negative is preserved here.

functions.name: test_gate_rejects_component_license_drift
functions.reason: One product packages the root MIT LICENSE. All five current source LICENSE copies have the same recorded SHA, but no active duplicate-copy mutation gate is claimed. Separate component-distribution license enforcement is retired.

functions.name: test_gate_rejects_component_without_a_registered_gate
functions.reason: Current four-role engine results and required signing rows replace removed COMPONENT_GATES script registration. Existing missing/failed-engine controls remain active; this historical script-name test is retained as history.

functions.name: test_gate_reports_a_failing_component_gate
functions.reason: Current engine result validation and workflow nonzero propagation reject actual failures, including failed/errored result bodies. The old component script dispatcher is no longer the supported gate.

functions.name: test_gate_rejects_ci_that_skips_a_component_or_a_required_step
functions.reason: Current source/tooling and role-by-architecture engine/report requirements replace old component-directory, tag and check_demo command literals. Existing current gates are not proof that every historical workflow mutation remains tested.

functions.name: test_gate_rejects_actions_that_are_not_sha_pinned
functions.replacement: Current immutable uses@SHA references and manual workflow SHA review; future action-pin mutation QA
functions.reason: Current action fetches are SHA-pinned. No active future-unpin mutation scanner is claimed; that automated negative is an explicit future source QA follow-up, not covered by test_workflow_calls flag checks.

functions.name: test_gate_rejects_an_unpinned_action_in_the_publish_workflow
functions.replacement: README.md; current .github/workflows/*.yml immutable references; future action-pin mutation QA
functions.reason: The specific PyPI publication workflow is retired for the Docker-only product. General current action pin review remains required and automated unpin mutation QA is explicitly tracked under future source QA.

functions.name: test_gate_requires_the_publish_workflow
functions.reason: The supported release route is the signed shared Docker product and assets. A separate publish-pypi.yml file is not its publication prerequisite; original bytes are retained without fabricating that workflow.

functions.name: test_gate_rejects_private_and_credential_markers
functions.reason: Current source and asset gates use the same mandatory privacy boundary. Existing generic credential/address/escape negatives are reused; only missing live edge controls are ported, not this entire duplicate corpus.

functions.name: test_gate_allows_documentation_addresses_and_reserved_domains
functions.reason: The existing current positive is extended with the missing original reserved/documentation boundary values. Existing official-doc positives remain, without duplicating a standalone address parser.

functions.name: test_gate_rejects_a_domain_outside_the_allowlist
functions.reason: The approved current-source port adds the previously missing disallowed-domain negative at the actual privacy boundary. Asset-domain checks alone were not treated as the same test.

functions.name: test_gate_rejects_an_address_that_ends_a_sentence
functions.reason: The approved current-source port preserves rejection of sentence-ending IPv4, IPv6 and domain forms through the existing shared rule; no new parser or broader policy is introduced.

functions.name: test_gate_still_reads_a_version_as_a_version
functions.reason: The version-looking text positive is preserved in the existing documented-values control. Product metadata consistency is a different obligation and is not falsely cited as this false-positive regression.

functions.name: test_gate_rejects_key_material_under_every_pem_header
functions.reason: The approved source port preserves all five original PEM-header material negatives and the header-only positive through existing privacy_text; runtime redaction tests are not substituted for this gate.

functions.name: test_gate_rejects_a_symbolic_link_in_place_of_a_reviewed_file
functions.reason: The approved port exercises the tracked-source regular-file boundary with a synthetic symlink, in addition to existing asset-link tests. It does not claim that the historical standalone checker is still run.

functions.name: test_gate_rejects_a_text_file_that_is_not_utf8
functions.reason: The original UTF-16LE/NUL refusal and an additional invalid-UTF8 case now target current tracked-source I/O. Existing asset encoding controls are related but are not passed off as the source-file negative.

functions.reason: The historical full-checker parent-alias case has no proven active automated counterpart. The compatibility edge is preserved explicitly for future source QA; ordinary current fixtures are not called equivalent alias coverage.

functions.reason: Broken relative-link detection is not supplied by source privacy or asset checks. Current manual review is the stated boundary; a future automated resolver negative remains future source QA work.

functions.reason: The historical resolver false-positive exclusions for code spans and fences are preserved, not relabeled as current automated enforcement. They belong with the explicit future source QA resolver follow-up.

functions.reason: The original checker deliberately ignored scheme links and pure anchors, even unresolved anchors. This is not anchor-resolution proof; the exact historical behavior remains archived for future source QA.

functions.reason: The old comment-stripped component/tag command graph is retired. Current real workflow commands and required role-result gates remain mandatory. No claim is made that lexical test_workflow_calls provides an equivalent comment-aware coverage parser.

functions.name: test_component_selector_cannot_disarm_the_gate
functions.reason: The component selector import/execution mechanism is retired. Current source checking imports trusted shared product rules and current manifest controls protect the shared distribution; no replacement selector framework is introduced.

functions.reason: The release process uses sealed clean commit inputs and current public-source/assets checks. The current checker reads tracked working-tree files, not staged blobs. No automated staged-versus-working-tree mutation guarantee is claimed.

functions.name: test_repository_gate_covers_the_real_tree
functions.reason: The old full-tree partition, component tags and PyPI graph cannot describe the shared Docker product. Current identity/artifact/engine/signing gates cover the supported model; precise OWNER boundaries are recorded separately rather than declaring blanket equivalence.

functions.reason: These anchor helpers were local to historical source-export tests, not a live product resolver. Their original heading/duplicate/encoded-fragment behavior is preserved without claiming current runtime or release execution.

functions.reason: This independent live source-count assertion is retained with unchanged oracle and baseline. Current source or engine result gates do not replace it; the measured-floor/source-count discrepancy must remain visible until separately resolved on evidence.

functions.name: test_except_branch_coverage_gate_refuses_a_lower_coverage
functions.reason: The original synthetic coverage/floor refusal controls are retained unchanged. Missing pinned coverage or pytest becomes an explicit error rather than print-and-return; no new framework or relaxed minimum is introduced.
